# nexus command get

List the commands, optionally by verb or noun

List every `nexus <noun> <verb>` command, one JSON object per line, sorted by noun and verb.

## Usage

```
nexus command get [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  nexus command get
  nexus command get --verb get
  nexus command get --noun container
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help          help for get
      --noun string   only commands with this noun
      --verb string   only commands with this verb
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```
